- 4 columns evenly spaced: "Input" (15%), "Estimation" (25%), "Correction" (25%), "Inference" (25%), with 5% side margins
- 2 horizontal swim lanes: top "Standard" (~32% height), bottom "EC-HTE" (~42% height), header (~12%), footer (~14%)

STANDARD TRACK (top swim lane):
- Continuous light rose background band (#FDF0ED, alpha=0.5, rounded corners 12px)
- Left margin label "Standard" (9pt bold, color #8B3A35)
- 3 white boxes left-to-right, all rounded 8px, border #D4A5A0 (1pt), white fill:
  [Est] Title: "Pooled CM  Ĉ" (11pt bold, #6B3A35). Subtitle: "One matrix for all" (9pt italic, #A07570)
  [Corr] Title: "Global Correction" (11pt bold, #6B3A35). Subtitle: "Ĉ⁻¹ applied uniformly" (9pt italic, #A07570)

EC-HTE TRACK (bottom swim lane):
